protocol.primary_question: With the existing M4 ranker features fixed, compare current four-grade approach-retreat training labels with four grades based on cursor AOI dwell.

grades.approach-retreat 4: 3 clicked; 2 approached and nested cursor-predicted deferred; 1 approached and predicted nondeferred; 0 other kept rows. Original four-grade source, not the three-grade collapse.
grades.dwell 4: 3 clicked regardless of dwell; 2 nonclicked dwell above the outer-training positive-nonclick median; 1 other positive nonclicked dwell, including median ties; 0 zero nonclicked dwell. No held-out rows or excluded training rows set thresholds.

protocol.gain_note: Unchanged LightGBM default exponential gain for labels 0/1/2/3; grade number is not gain value.
protocol.raw_dwell: Sum of milliseconds of cursor containment in strict XY typed rectangles, no margin or minimum visit duration. Zero-order hold of native mousemove viewport coordinates, updated into document space at scroll events. Observation interval: first through last retained native mousemove, matching M4 temporal extent. No gaze.
protocol.cutoff: Strictly before final mousedown minus 500 ms for all cursor observations
protocol.inclusion: Canonical fixed NotApprBelow mask for every arm. Uses approach min_dist and clicked position to select training rows; all candidates scored at test, including in dwell-feature arms.
protocol.split: Outer participant LOSO. A-R training labels generated by inner participant LOSO strictly inside outer training fold, using fixed full M4 labeler. Dwell thresholds use outer training data only.
protocol.evaluation: Canonical per-trial NDCG@10 and MRR@10 against binary held-out clicks, with original tie handling. Neither method evaluated against its own training grades.
protocol.uncertainty: Pair participant means of per-trial scores; bootstrap 10000 resamples seed 20260904. Wilcoxon plus Holm across 10 contrasts per metric; NDCG primary, MRR secondary. Outer training folds overlap.
protocol.limits: Offline post-interaction behavioral ranking; no new independent relevance judgments. The dwell median split is a prespecified control, not an optimized dwell model. A-R grade source remains supervised by gaze-regression training labels. Grade frequencies need not match even though four levels and gain schedule do.
